name: Level residual (global z-score)
interpretability: High — identical to frozen Hybrid residual target
reconstruction_complexity: None — output is final scaled residual
leakage_risk: Low — global μ/σ from train only
information_assessment: Baseline level residual retains full Prophet-complement signal including slow components and heavy-tail spikes. Observed lag-1 |ACF|=0.361, mean |ACF| (1–96)=0.035, integrated τ median=0.5.

name: First-order difference (velocity)
interpretability: Medium — velocity requires integration back to level
inference_complexity: Medium — integrate Δ with train anchor r_T
leakage_risk: Low — Δ stats from train; anchor from train tail
information_assessment: Amplifies short-lag dynamics; differencing removes slow drift and can sharpen local temporal structure at the cost of level memory. Observed lag-1 |ACF|=0.337, mean |ACF| (1–96)=0.012, integrated τ median=0.0.

name: Per-container normalization
interpretability: High — per-container scale, same physical units after inverse
leakage_risk: Low — container μ/σ from train only
information_assessment: Preserves relative temporal shape within each container; cross-container amplitude differences are removed. Observed lag-1 |ACF|=0.361, mean |ACF| (1–96)=0.035, integrated τ median=0.5.

name: Robust scaling (median/MAD)
interpretability: Medium — robust scale less familiar than z-score
information_assessment: Down-weights extreme tails; temporal shape largely preserved but outlier-driven dynamics may be suppressed. Observed lag-1 |ACF|=0.361, mean |ACF| (1–96)=0.035, integrated τ median=0.5.
